title: Twilight Drive — Night Circuit
prompt: Compose an original instrumental dark synthwave soundtrack for a fast electric sports-car night drive. Confident medium-energy driving groove at exactly 104 BPM in 4/4. Punchy electronic kick, powerful gated snare backbeat, crisp syncopated hi-hats, and a deep pulsing analog synthesizer bass ostinato. Minor-key cinematic analog synth chords, an original memorable restrained synth motif, and rhythmic sixteenth-note arpeggios. Nostalgic 1980s retro-futuristic neon highway atmosphere, moody, dark, propulsive and stylish, with a strong audible beat throughout. Full polished stereo production with warm saturated synths and firm drums. Not ambient, not lo-fi, not chillout, no sleepy soft drums. Exactly 44 bars, approximately 101.54 seconds. Start immediately on a full established groove on the downbeat. Maintain the same tempo and repeating four-bar minor harmonic cycle throughout, adding subtle rhythmic variations without breakdowns. End with the same groove and opening harmony ready to repeat. No fade-in, no fade-out, no silent intro, no outro, no dramatic ending. All melodies and sounds must be original; do not quote or sample existing music. Strictly instrumental: no lyrics, singing, speech, vocal samples, choirs, whispers, or vocoder. Leave room around the music for tire and wind sounds.
